CustomField.description: Calculates the Data Quality Score and displays it in color bar.
CustomField.formula:
IF(TEXT(Region__c)="Florida", IMAGE("/img/samples/color_green.gif", "Complete", 10, IF(ISBLANK(FirstName) ,0,20)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Gender__c)) ,0,10)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Provider_Type__c)) ,0,10)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Credentials__c)) ,0,20)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Affiliation__c)) ,0,20)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Affiliation_Group__c)) ,0,20)) &
IMAGE("/img/samples/color_red.gif", "Incomplete", 10, IF(ISBLANK(FirstName) ,20,00)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Gender__c)) ,10,0)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Provider_Type__c)) ,10,0)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Credentials__c)) ,20,0)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Affiliation__c)) ,20,0)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Affiliation_Group__c)) ,20,0)) & " " & TEXT ( IF(ISBLANK(FirstName) ,0,20)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Gender__c)) ,0,10)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Provider_Type__c)) ,0,10)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Credentials__c)) ,0,20)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Affiliation__c)) ,0,20)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Affiliation_Group__c)) ,0,20)) & "%",
IMAGE("/img/samples/color_green.gif", "Complete", 10, IF(ISBLANK(FirstName) ,0,25)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Gender__c)) ,0,25)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Provider_Type__c)) ,0,25)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Credentials__c)) ,0,25)) &
IMAGE("/img/samples/color_red.gif", "Incomplete", 10, IF(ISBLANK(FirstName) ,25,00)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Gender__c)) ,25,0)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Provider_Type__c)) ,25,0)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Credentials__c)) ,25,0)) & " " & TEXT ( IF(ISBLANK(FirstName) ,0,25)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Gender__c)) ,0,25)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Provider_Type__c)) ,0,25)+ IF(ISBLANK(TEXT(Credentials__c)) ,0,25)) & "%")
CustomField.label: Data Quality Score
